items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So who was in the band when you got in the NBC Orchestra, NBC Band, who was in that band, the Tonight Show Band? ... Jimmy Maxwell

ctx.x: So who was in the band when you got in the NBC Orchestra, NBC Band, who was in that band, the Tonight Show Band?

Tonight Show Band? Let‘s see, Clark Terry… Jimmy Maxwell … I can‘t think of these other two guys, I‘m seeing them, but I can‘t call their names… I can‘t call their names, I‘ll just hold you up trying to think …
